verdict.rationale: While incident.io exposes a REST API, OpenAPI specs, and an MCP server for querying incidents/alerts/on-call data, none of the evidence describes bulk/batch operations (e.g., bulk update, bulk close, batch endpoints, or MCP tools operating on many items at once) — all API/MCP references describe per-item query or single-action operations. This is a fair axis for a product with a full API and MCP surface, but no evidence shows bulk-operation support.
